ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (light grey/white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels. Low-intensity pixels are primarily concentrated in a wide central vertical column and at the distal tip of the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity band extends from the peduncle base to the median notch. The left lobe contains a low-intensity cluster at the distal tip and several small, discrete low-intensity spots along the medial trailing edge. The right lobe is predominantly high-intensity with a low-intensity margin at the base of the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body and an estimated pixel angle of 30-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge features small-scale, high-frequency serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a major macro-topographical discontinuity characterized by a deep, rectangular-shaped step-down or missing segment near the distal third, creating a jagged, multi-tiered profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature sweeping outward from the notch, though the right lobe trajectory is significantly disrupted by a deep geometric indentation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several discrete, circular low-intensity pixel clusters are visible on the medial light-colored surface of the left lobe, concentrated near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major acquired deformity on the trailing edge of the right lobe, featuring a deep, irregular indentation that has removed a significant portion of the lobe's distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe presents a unique 'stepped' or 'double-tip' appearance caused by the deep trailing edge indentation.
